standard.title: Transition Joints of Cables for Working Voltages from 11 kV Up to and Including 33 kV — Performance Requirements and Type Tests (11 कि. वो. से 33 कि. वो. तक कार्यकारी वोल्टता के केबलों के लिए संक्रमण जोड़ — कार्यकािरता अपेक्षाएं और टाइप परीक्षण)
standard.description: This Indian Standard prescribes the performance requirements, testing configurations, and type testing sequences for transition joints between paper-insulated lead-sheathed (PILC) cables and polymeric insulated power cables (such as XLPE, EPR, or PVC) for voltage grades ranging from 11 kV up to and including 33 kV.
standard.scope: This Indian Standard prescribes the performance requirements, testing configurations, and type testing sequences for transition joints between paper-insulated lead-sheathed (PILC) cables and polymeric insulated power cables (such as XLPE, EPR, or PVC) for voltage grades ranging from 11 kV up to and including 33 kV.

supersedes: None (Developed as a new standalone standard based on the international adoption of IEC 60502-4 principles to govern high-voltage transition joints)

certification.description: Voluntary Product Testing Standard. However, under state distribution utility specifications (such as WBSEDCL, BESCOM, and state electricity boards), splicing kits and transition joints supplied for utility network upgrades must carry certified lab test records demonstrating full compliance with the type-testing sequence of IS 13705.
requirements: Observed or calculated final test values, conductor resistance, test temperatures, and withstand voltages must be mathematically rounded off in accordance with IS 2:1960. The decimal places retained should match that of the specified value in the standard.

Specifies transition joints connecting PILC cables with cross-sections between 120 and 300 sq mm to polymer insulated cables of one size lower cross section (or to PVC of one size higher cross section).
The test specimen may consist of two transition joints in series to allow simultaneous testing and statistical verification of the assembly.
Standardizes clearances: total specimen length >= 5 m, terminal neck spacing >= 2 m, and joint-to-joint spacing (if applicable) >= 3 m.

Type tests and their sequence must follow the strict chronological flow specified in Table 1 (initial conductor resistance, impact testing, subsequent load cycles, impulse testing, and final high-voltage withstand checks).
If a transition joint does not pass any particular test in the sequence, the entire type tests must be repeated on a freshly prepared test specimen.
Done in accordance with IS 10810 (Part 5) : 1984 to ensure the jointing ferrules and connectors do not generate localized hot-spots under high load currents.

The joint is placed on concrete, and a wedge-shaped mass of 4 kg (having a 90-degree angle with a 2 mm radius impacting edge) must be dropped freely 6 times from a height of 2 m onto the joint. Visible damage is prohibited.
